rule: Use the same measurement of another vegetable you prefer, generally excluding potato when the source specifies that exception.
Use the same measurement of another fruit you prefer; avocado is treated separately in source substitution tables.
Use the same amount of quinoa or black rice; white rice is listed as a fallback in source guides.
Source plans permit equal-amount grain swaps in several contexts.
Any other nut butter may be substituted where the source allows it.
Regular plain yogurt is listed when necessary, although the source notes Greek yogurt is higher in protein.
Use gluten-free bread/pasta versions or substitute brown rice/quinoa where appropriate.
Choose an appropriately portioned Fit Girl's Choice of Protein according to the source plan.
